title: recovery-disposition contract data
description: Reference schema (FAFF-820). The SHAPE of `faff bundle-recover`'s read-only recovery disposition over a discovered-and-verified Phase 0 recovery bundle: reconstructed / noop-already-present / refused, with the source bundle's own verdict/identity and a resume-or-park preview. The verb writes no owner state and makes no forge call — recovery-disposition documents ONLY what was discovered/reconstructed and previewed, never a continuation decision (that stays `faff lights-out --resume`). Coercion target for a malformed/out-of-enum disposition is `refused` (never `reconstructed`) — the bundle-verdict never-guess-green precedent, extended to this contract's own safe-failure value.

bundle_identity.description: BundleIdentity | null — the source bundle's identity, populated whenever discovery found and verified one (even a non-CLEAN candidate); null only when nothing was found at all.

run_id.description: The recovered run's id, or the empty string when discovery never resolved one (e.g. no candidate found at all).

run_dir.description: String | null — the reconstructed (or already-present) run directory path. Always null on a refused disposition; always non-null on reconstructed/noop-already-present.

resume_preview.description: ResumePlan | null — reconstructResumePlan's own shape {skip, continue_review, continue_from_push, redispatch, park, terminal, drain_remainder}, unchanged. Null only on a refused disposition.

dry_run.description: Optional (default false when absent). True when this disposition was computed against a scratch --dry-run materialisation rather than the real root — the real root was left untouched even though disposition may read reconstructed.
